content.text: The implementation matches a careful re-derivation — my quick expectations were wrong in all three: retry legitimately emits its repeat upstream ACK **before** retransmissions (trace `[0,1,2,3,0,1,2,3,0,0,3,3,3,3]` = ack+retransmit per retry), budget 3 admits 3 emissions (ack + 2 results), and reducescatter receivers have a single q=0 record so `upto>1` prefixes clamp to 1. Fixing expectations:
